question: Where and when will the fourth edition of the Winter Youth Olympic Games be held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2024 Gangwon.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In 2024**, the fourth edition of the Winter Youth Olympic Games will be held in **Gangwon, South Korea.**
 
• **The 2022 **Winter Olympic Games were held in **Beijing, China**
 
• **The 2026** Winter Olympic Games will be held in **Italy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Summer Olympic Games**

 
 
• The **2020 Summer Olympic** Games were held in **Tokyo, Japan.**
 
• The **2024 Summer Olympic **Games will be held in **Paris**.
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **The Winter Olympic Games**

 
 
• It is a sporting event that occurs every four years.
 
• The first celebration of the Winter Olympics was held in Chamonix, France, in 1924. 
 
• **The original sports were alpine and cross-country skiing, figure skating, ice hockey, Nordic combined, ski jumping, and speed skating.**
 
• The Games were held every four years from **1924 until 1936, **after which they were interrupted by World War II.
 
• The Olympics resumed in 1948 and were celebrated every four years.
